approval.note: A composed script is a draft. A human reads it before this film is published anywhere.

script.vo01: Compliance is checked in bursts, usually when an audit is coming. Contract managers have no live view of whether their suppliers still meet the standard once the standard changes.
script.vo02: Licences are bought without a reliable read of how they are actually used, and the gap only surfaces at renewal.
script.vo03: It reads Regulatory updates and standards, Supplier and contract records. It engages you in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams. And it can watch for changes to the standards that govern a contract, showing the reasoning behind every answer.
script.vo04: A contract manager asks who has fallen out of compliance since the standard changed. The agent compares the new requirements against supplier records and returns the affected contracts with the clause behind each.
script.vo05: Asked for a plan, the agent orders the gaps by how long they take to close, names an owner for each, and separates the ones that need a contract change.
script.vo06: On risk, the agent explains what treating the remainder as compliant would assume, and names the suppliers whose evidence is out of date rather than absent.
script.vo_payoff: Compliance becomes something teams watch continuously rather than discover in the week before an audit.
script.vo_helps: The result? Continuous monitoring, gaps surfaced while they can still be closed, and multi-source reporting made comparable without hand-standardisation.
script.vo_cta: Get started on your agentic journey today. Talk to your Microsoft representative to learn more.
